cards.example_en: He hurt his thumb while cutting vegetables for dinner.
cards.example_zh: 他晚饭切菜时伤到了拇指。

cards.example_en: Remember to tick the correct answer on your test paper.
cards.example_zh: 记得在试卷上给正确答案打勾。

cards.example_en: While we walked along the beach, the tide came in quickly.
cards.example_zh: 我们沿海滩走的时候，潮水很快涨了上来。

cards.example_en: Check the train timetable before you leave for the station.
cards.example_zh: 去车站之前先查看火车时刻表。

cards.example_en: On the way to my uncle's farm, the front tyre went flat.
cards.example_zh: 去叔叔农场的路上，前轮胎瘪了。

cards.example_en: She stubbed her toe on the chair while walking to the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 她走向厨房时，脚趾撞到了椅子。

cards.example_en: Drivers must pay a toll before they enter this long highway.
cards.example_zh: 司机进入这条长公路之前必须缴纳通行费。

cards.example_en: At lunch today, the hot soup burned my tongue.
cards.example_zh: 今天午饭时，热汤烫到了我的舌头。

cards.example_en: I packed a toothbrush and a towel for the weekend trip.
cards.example_zh: 我为周末旅行装了一把牙刷和一条毛巾。

cards.example_en: We are almost out of toothpaste, so please buy a new tube.
cards.example_zh: 牙膏快用完了，请再买一支。

cards.example_en: After the rain, the tortoise moved slowly across the garden.
cards.example_zh: 雨后，乌龟慢慢地爬过了花园。

cards.example_en: Police can trace the lost bag through the cameras.
cards.example_zh: 警方可以通过摄像头追踪丢失的包。

cards.example_en: We took a tram across the old city to reach the museum.
cards.example_zh: 我们坐有轨电车穿过老城区，去了博物馆。

cards.example_en: Carry this tray of cups into the dining room before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭前把这托盘上的杯子端进餐厅。

cards.example_en: Draw a triangle with three equal sides in your maths book.
cards.example_zh: 在数学书上画一个三边相等的三角形。

cards.example_en: She made a tuna sandwich for the picnic by the river.
cards.example_zh: 她为河边野餐做了一个金枪鱼三明治。

cards.example_en: Near the school pond, a small turtle rested on a rock.
cards.example_zh: 在学校池塘边，一只小海龟趴在石头上。

cards.example_en: You should twist the bottle cap so the juice does not leak.
cards.example_zh: 你应该把瓶盖拧紧，这样果汁才不会漏出来。

cards.example_en: Children love the huge tyrannosaurus model in the city museum.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们喜欢城市博物馆里那个巨大的霸王龙模型。

cards.example_en: Students should underline new words and copy them into notebooks.
cards.example_zh: 学生应该在生词下面画线，并抄进笔记本。

cards.example_en: My football was underneath the bed after the game.
cards.example_zh: 比赛结束以后，我的足球在床底下。

cards.example_en: Climbing the city wall at night became an unforgettable memory for us.
cards.example_zh: 夜里爬城墙成了我们一段难忘的回忆。

cards.example_en: Your school bag is upstairs beside the bed in your room.
cards.example_zh: 你的书包在楼上，就在你房间的床边。

cards.example_en: Tonight the hotel near the station still has a vacancy.
cards.example_zh: 今晚车站附近的酒店还有一间空房。

cards.example_en: Nothing can live for long in a vacuum without air or water.
cards.example_zh: 没有空气和水，没有生物能在真空中活很久。

cards.example_en: Every morning a white van delivered fresh bread to the shop.
cards.example_zh: 每天早晨，一辆白色厢式货车给商店送来新鲜面包。

cards.example_en: After the sun rises over the hills, the fog will vanish.
cards.example_zh: 太阳从山上出来以后，雾就会散去。

cards.example_en: My aunt is a vegetarian, so she never eats meat or fish.
cards.example_zh: 我阿姨是素食者，所以她从不吃肉或鱼。

cards.example_en: He chose vegetarianism because he cares about animals and health.
cards.example_zh: 他选择素食主义，是因为他关心动物和健康。

cards.example_en: Circle the verb in each sentence and say what it means.
cards.example_zh: 圈出每个句子里的动词，并说出它的意思。

cards.example_en: He wore a warm vest under his coat on the cold morning.
cards.example_zh: 寒冷的早晨，他在外套里面穿了一件暖和的背心。

cards.example_en: They rented a quiet villa near the sea for the summer holiday.
cards.example_zh: 他们为暑假在海边租了一栋安静的别墅。

cards.example_en: Oranges give you vitamin C, so eat one after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 橙子能给你维生素C，所以午饭后吃一个吧。

cards.example_en: In the busy restaurant, the waitress brought us noodles and tea.
cards.example_zh: 在热闹的餐馆里，女服务员给我们端来了面条和茶。

cards.example_en: My winter coat hangs in the wardrobe beside my bed.
cards.example_zh: 我的冬衣挂在床边的衣柜里。

cards.example_en: When a stranger walked past our gate, the watchdog barked loudly.
cards.example_zh: 陌生人走过我家大门时，看门狗大声叫了起来。

cards.example_en: Students search the web for the club timetable.
cards.example_zh: 学生们在网上查找社团的时间表。

cards.example_en: Open the school webpage to see the date of the sports meeting.
cards.example_zh: 打开学校网页，查看运动会的日期。

cards.example_en: The soup tasted weird because I added too much salt.
cards.example_zh: 这汤味道奇怪，因为我盐放得太多了。

cards.example_en: Near the city library, a well-dressed man stopped to ask the way.
cards.example_zh: 在市图书馆附近，一位穿着讲究的男士停下来问路。

cards.example_en: Sit wherever you like.
cards.example_zh: 你喜欢坐哪儿就坐哪儿。

cards.example_en: Our class whiz-kid solved the hard puzzle before anyone else.
cards.example_zh: 我们班的神童比谁都先解开了那道难题。

cards.example_en: Birds, deer, and foxes are wildlife that this park protects.
cards.example_zh: 鸟、鹿和狐狸是这座公园保护的野生动物。

cards.example_en: Wow! You finished the puzzle so fast.
cards.example_zh: 哇！你这么快就拼完了。

cards.example_en: I began to yawn during the long bus ride back home.
cards.example_zh: 坐长途汽车回家时，我开始打哈欠。

cards.example_en: She answered yeah and agreed to meet me at the bookstore after school.
cards.example_zh: 她回答说是的，并同意放学后在书店跟我见面。

cards.example_en: When they tasted the tomato soup, the children all said yum.
cards.example_zh: 他们尝到番茄汤时，孩子们都说好吃。

cards.example_en: Near the fence, the zoo keeper fed the zebra some fresh grass.
cards.example_zh: 在围栏边，动物园饲养员给斑马喂了些新鲜的草。

cards.example_en: When I tried to close my backpack, the zip stuck badly.
cards.example_zh: 我试图拉上背包时，拉链严重卡住了。

cards.example_en: A small aircraft flew over the sports field at noon.
cards.example_zh: 中午，一架小型飞机从运动场上空飞过。
